verdict.rationale: Morph documents a standard OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint: you point any OpenAI SDK at its base URL, and existing OpenAI code needs only a new model string. It also natively serves the Anthropic Messages API and documents moving agents off Anthropic/OpenAI. A community user independently confirms the OpenAI-compatible endpoint worked with a third-party CLI tool. missing for 10: documented parity of chat-completions parameters such as tool calling and streaming, and explicit evidence of switching mid-workflow within a single agent session.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes

citations.quote: Kimi K3 serves 1M context through the standard chat completions endpoint, so existing OpenAI code only needs a new `model` string
Claude Code speaks the Anthropic Messages API, which Morph serves natively at `/v1/messages`.
This uses an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so got this working with my llm.datasette.io CLI tool
